# Color

Every color a PLUS screen uses, as the palette it comes from and the named roles that follow the Color mode.

**Kind:** Foundation

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/styles/TokensColor.mdx`

## Overview

Roles such as text, surface and border give a palette step a job and switch with the Light, Dark and high-contrast modes ([Color](?path=/docs/foundations-visual-color--docs)). A screen binds a role, never a palette step.
